sanjay: quick RFC follow-up — we should stop treating the shared runtime as one big monolith. proposal: a tiny hot-path core + loadable capability modules (caching, prefix-kv, admission, telemetry). helps isolate tech debt and ownership, but increases surface area. initial tradeoffs?
maria: sounds promising. my immediate worry is inter-module latency (cross-tenant RPC). we need SLO guards if modules move off the local hot path.
kai: agree on isolation. important: the capability API must forbid blocking IO on the hot path and be deterministic. sketch: `CapabilityV1 { init(ctx), handle(req) -> resp }` and a tiny handshake for version negotiation.
anya: operational note — we should pick a low-risk first extraction like prefix-cache. extract it as a capability, run it colocated, then try remote. that will show perf + failure modes. canary at 25%?
sanjay: +1. rough migration plan i have in mind:
```
1) define minimal Capability API + version header
2) extract prefix cache as CapabilityV1 prototype
3) run 2-week perf/observability study (latency, token cost, error surface)
4) iterate and decide expansion/ownership split
rollback: revert routing to monolith if p50/p95 regress > 10% or error rate spike > 0.3%
```
maria: telemetry needs to be first-class: per-capability latency histograms, "tokens-per-response" delta, error-class counters, and a small dashboard. also alert on contract negotiation failures. i'll own the dashboards. :thumbsup:
kai: we should also add a contract-test harness (integration-level golden tests) that runs in CI and a runtime header `X-Capability-Version` for negotiation/compat. i'll take that on.
anya: implementation caution: keep dynamic module binary small. prefer shared object + exported symbols rather than heavy runtime embedding. avoid GC pressure and extra memory flows in the hot path. i can prototype the linker shim.
ci-bot: deploy 2024-08-11T16:02:12Z succeeded (infra/prod)
sanjay: i'll draft the short RFC with API sketch, migration milestones, and rollbacks. planning to have a first draft EOD tomorrow. if anyone wants to pair on the prototype, ping me here.
maria: i'll block 2 eng-days for telemetry integration next sprint.
kai: i'll own version negotiation + contract tests, will post a checklist later.
anya: i'll start the prefix-cache spike next week and post perf numbers.
sanjay: thanks — seems like a small, safe first slice that buys better long-term ownership and reduces entangled debt.
